title: mentha × kerneri var. pycnotricha
intro: Mentha × kerneri var. pycnotricha, commonly known as Corsican mint, is a hybrid plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including aiding digestion and alleviating symptoms of nausea and indigestion. The therapeutic actions of Corsican mint include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, isomenthone, and menthol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
